PREVIEW SPECIFICATION / 14 OCTOBER 2026

01

A concept preview

The site illustrates proposed modules and a supervised procurement workflow. It does not establish an operating SaaS, accepted prices, customers, certifications or live integrations.

02

Synthetic records

Forgefield Services, the suppliers, owners, quotes and outcomes in the demo are fictional. The demo is not procurement advice or an executed sourcing event.

03

Nonbinding drafts and disabled actions

A simulated approval is a demonstration state. Draft exports are labeled DEMO and are not purchase orders. Sending, binding acceptance, ERP writes, funds transfers and payment are disabled.

04

Hypothetical pricing

The $2,500 category pilot and $1,000–$3,500 monthly category range are test hypotheses. There is no active checkout or commercial acceptance represented here.

05

Human authority and supplier choice

Real pilot scope would require a named owner, authorized envelope, supplier consent and source review. No demo action establishes real authority or bypasses policy, contract or consent.

06

Legal review before operational launch

These preview terms are an informational draft. Company details, actual service terms, data handling and legal position require review before real intake or an operating service.
